posts.text:
LAW DORK: Thursday was the worst day for DOJ. So far.

DOJ withdrew its subpoenas issued to New York Times reporters, but the hearing that preceded that decision showed just how degraded DOJ has become.
posts.summary: Criticizes DOJ degradation over NYT subpoena handling
